sections.description: Royal BatchMate is a complete community, membership directory, reunion, and event management platform for WordPress. Built for SSC, HSC, and University alumni batches.
sections.changelog:
• 26.11.18: Fixed frontend event form render issue caused by unexpected closing brace syntax error.
  • 26.11.17: Fixed 'Failed to save non-member information' root cause (varchar column overflow on long event names). Enqueued Select2 and SweetAlert2 on frontend for Elementor event forms. Added required field validation popup with red highlights, smooth auto-focus, and preserved form data on error.
  • 26.11.16: Auto-migration guard for missing database columns in rawdata and application tables.
  • 26.11.15: Fixed Guest Options (Family/Guest fees) not showing on Direct Form (Option 4). Removed duplicate Labels card from Registration Settings.
  • 26.11.14: English labels for event registration modal, auto-updater UTF-8 BOM resilience, and cache busting fixes.
  • 26.11.13: Added Option 4 (Direct Form Only) to Edit Event modal to bypass profile search.
  • 26.11.12: Fixed activation 3 characters unexpected output (UTF-8 BOM removal). Fixed Event CC Email delivery.
  • 26.11.11: Added dedicated Elementor Event Form Widget with live style customization.
